sn1.30:1.1: Enijaṅghaṃ kisaṃ vīraṃ || appāhāram alolupaṃ || sīhaṃ v-ekacaraṃ nāgam ||kāmesu anapekkhinaṃ || upasaṅkamma pucchāma || kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccatīti || ||
sn1.30:2.1: Pañcakāmaguṇā loke || mano chaṭṭhā paveditā || ettha chandaṃ virājetvā || evaṃ dukkhā pamuccatīti || || Satti-vaggo tatiyo || ||
sn1.30:3.0: Tatr-uddānam || Sattiyā Phusati c-eva || Jaṭā Manonivāraṇā || Arahantena Pajjoto || Sarā Mahaddhanena ca || Catucakkena navamaṃ || Enijaṅghena te dasāti || || ___________________________________________
